Kerendia is the closest marketed product in mechanism and setting: the only non-steroidal MR agent in the US, approved on 2025-07-11 for heart failure with LVEF 40% or above (openFDA, NDA215341 efficacy supplement 9, in the book's supplements table) and labelled in CKD with type 2 diabetes. Branded heart failure products sit close by in the same 2025 file: Farxiga $4,727, Jardiance $5,066, Verquvo $4,829, Entresto $4,751, and AstraZeneca's own dapagliflozin combination Xigduo XR $4,773. Case for higher: the sum of Kerendia and Farxiga, $9,567. Kerendia's per-beneficiary figure is still rising with its ramp ($1,493, $2,857, $4,239 and $4,493 over 2021 to 2024 in drug_demand, $4,839 in 2025), so a part-year effect remains

column12: Judgement: the MRA rate is taken, not the SGLT2 inhibitor rate, because a patient who stops the MR component for potassium or kidney function stops the combination and returns to dapagliflozin alone. The setting matches BalanceD-HF's entry criterion, a recent heart failure event, and the data are US. Case against: a first-year rate applied to the whole stock every year overstates later-year stopping; 44.2% of steroidal MRA discontinuers restarted within a median 91 days in US claims (Richard EL et al., Pragmat Obs Res 2025;16:27-37, doi:10.2147/POR.S489791, PMID 40034401); and EVOLUTION HF pooled across Japan, Sweden and the US gives lower 12-month rates, 23.5% for dapagliflozin and 42.2% for MRAs (Savarese G et al., JACC Heart Fail 2023;11(1):1-14, doi:10.1016/j.jchf.2022.08.009, PMID 36202739). A single daily capsule may persist better than two pills

column11: Two filters from BalanceD-HF's entry criteria (NCT06307652, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2: a heart failure event within 6 months, eGFR 20 to under 60). (1) A heart failure event: 26.8% of 16,646 patients with chronic HFrEF, 4,460, had a worsening event, a heart failure hospitalisation or IV diuretics, within the 12-month assessment period ('Clinical and Economic Burden of Chronic Heart Failure and Reduced Ejection Fraction Following a Worsening Heart Failure Event', Adv Ther 2020, doi:10.1007/s12325-020-01456-1, PMID 32761552, PMC7444407; IBM MarketScan Commercial and Medicare Supplemental, 2015 to 2018). (2) eGFR under 60: 234,332 of 365,494 heart failure hospitalisations (64%) in GWTG-HF, 2014 to 2019 (Patel RB et al., 'Kidney Function and Outcomes in Patients Hospitalized With Heart Failure', J Am Coll Cardiol 2021;78(4):330-343, doi:10.1016/j.jacc.2021.05.002, PMID 33989713). 0.268 x 0.64 = 0.17152, about 1.27mm of the book's 7.4mm
column12: The second share is measured among hospitalised patients, so it is already conditional on an event and the two multiply without an independence assumption. No ejection-fraction filter: the trial requires an LVEF reading within 12 months but sets no cut-off. Case for lower: the trial requires the event within 6 months, not 12, and halving the first share gives 0.086. The 64% includes patients below eGFR 20 and the 5% on dialysis, whom the trial excludes. The 26.8% comes from commercially and Medicare-supplemental insured HFrEF patients identified from claims, a sicker definition than the book's self-reported 7.4mm. Case for higher: older and HFpEF patients are hospitalised at least as often, and the label may drop the recent-event criterion, as the current US heart failure labels for Farxiga, Jardiance and Kerendia carry none. Verquvo's label does carry one (use following a heart failure hospitalisation or outpatient IV diuretics). Not applied: the trial also excludes current MRA users and requires NT-proBNP above 300 pg/mL, and a label would not restrict either

column11: Solved on the engine's own path (forecast.derive_new_patients then treated_stock, at this asset's 0.57 stopping, nil inflow and carryover 1.0) to Verquvo's CMS Part D beneficiaries: 1,361 (2021, launched in January), 4,689, 8,218 and 11,127 (2022 to 2024, drug_demand) and 13,414 (2025, quarterly companion 4ff7c618-4e40-483a-b390-c8a58c94fa15, row '2025 (Q1-Q4)'), over its label pool of 991,600: the book's 7.4mm adults with heart failure x 0.5 with reduced ejection fraction (epidemiology.csv note) x the same 26.8% with a worsening event this asset's eligible_pct uses (PMID 32761552). The least-squares fit is a peak of 0.008978 a year with k 1.19 and midpoint 1.255 years, reproducing 1,633, 4,477, 8,195, 11,341 and 13,283 (rmse 191)
column12: Judgement: a multiple of 1.0. Verquvo is the last branded add-on launched into the same patients, labelled for use following a hospitalisation for heart failure or need for outpatient IV diuretics in adults with ejection fraction below 45% (openFDA label, effective 2026-01-21), the post-event setting BalanceD-HF enrols. Corroboration: Kerendia, the same MR prescribing decision, fitted the same way to 25,931, 63,625, 88,208 and 121,794 Part D beneficiaries (2022 to 2025) over its CKD with type 2 diabetes pool of 11.07mm (41% of the book's 27.0mm adults with type 2 diabetes), gives 0.00965 (k 0.74, midpoint 1.335, rmse 3,141); its 2025 point carries half a year of the heart failure label, and on 2022 to 2024 alone the fit gives 0.00567. The value written before, 0.0063, was solved on a logistic fitted to Kerendia's beneficiary stock and then used as the penetration ramp, which reads a stock as penetration. Both numerators are Medicare Part D only, so both understate an all-payer capture. The modelled US treated stock settles near 19,000 by year 7. Case for higher: AstraZeneca's own $3-5bn non-risk-adjusted peak year revenue for balcinrenone/dapagliflozin (Investor Day 2024, BioPharmaceuticals presentation p19) rests on 12 million patients with heart failure and CKD in the top eight markets (p18), a count with no recent-event filter stated, and on the CKD indication as well; it is the company's figure, not an independent forecast, and no broker or aggregator peak was found (GlobalData's likelihood-of-approval page on pharmaceutical-technology.com gives none). AstraZeneca can also move patients from its own dapagliflozin franchise to one capsule, a channel Bayer did not have for Kerendia. Case for lower: finerenone will have been labelled in heart failure for three years by launch, and the MR component faces generic spironolactone and eplerenone
